methodology.inputs: Observed adjusted-close fund returns on the exact formal windows,including the first day's return from its actual previous close. No target weights,account simulation,fees,Sharpe,CAGR or strategy selection is calculated.
methodology.risk_dimensions: Report both covariance and correlation participation-ratio dimensions. Covariance reflects unscaled observed variance; correlation normalizes asset volatilities. Neither is the number of proven independent economic alpha factors.
methodology.market_model: In-sample OLS with an intercept and SPY excess return,using the frozen lagged risk-free series. Report beta,R-squared and residual dependence;do not use fitted coefficients as forecasts or pretend residual series are tradable long-only investments.
methodology.rolling: The same descriptive analysis on252-session trailing windows ending at completed month ends. Overlapping rolling windows are not independent validation samples or bootstrap confidence.
methodology.prior_art: Cross-check the original four-asset results with the unchanged exposure_diagnostics helper. Its preserved legacy covariance_effective_dimension field is correlation-based;do not silently rewrite old reports.
methodology.interpretation: New source-verified size and share-issuance definitions remain queued and unregistered. A different catalog family does not establish uncorrelated returns,incremental alpha or improvement of the pending six-family candidate strategies.
methodology.scope: Read-only post-source-check descriptive research. All108complete strategy trials,24reviews,weekly definition limits,queued eligibility,source receipts and investment goals remain unchanged.
